title: Great app, but need many UX improvements
body:
Overall this serves its function well. But the UX is not that good. For example, there should be a setting where users has the option to hide completed Dailies, instead of just marking them as done. This is important for people who set many Dailies, as this will declutter the Dailies screen.

Another thing, Dailies itself not only serves for tasks that are recurring daily, but also weekly or even monthly. There should be a way to separate the three. Also, I find it inefficient to show daily tasks that I need to do 4-7 days from now on the same screen as today tasks. I’d prefer for them to be available a day before on my Dailies screen, instead of showing all the recurring tasks.

title: Great app but there's still room for improvement
body:
A great app for managing your habits and tasks, but all apps have a bug or problem. For this one, it's the loading time. It's so slow, whenever I open the app, it always take a couple of minutes to fully load (especially for the first time for the day). Besides that, there's nothing that really bugs me.

Suggestion :
Please add a widget feature for the app, so that I could mark down tasks without opening the app.
